about: Questions a user might type to the assistant (English only), made from the examples of the app: each one a real task. 'expect': the nodes that should be proposed, in order (node types); 'alt': other answers that are also right; 'detail': what the recipe should fill in from the question; 'kind': clear, vague (several ways), jargon (words not in the node names), typo, chain (several steps), from-node (asked with a node selected), detail (numbers, rows, units or names to fill in), other-app (the words of Origin, Excel, ImageJ, Python), none (out of scope: expect empty, the assistant should say so and offer Help). To be checked and completed by hand; the tests aim at top-1 >= 85 % and top-3 >= 95 %.
